arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: General Underwood stated the Controlled Substances Act prohibits distribution. She cited congressional and executive determinations against medical use. She noted the drug has high abuse potential.
Mr. Uelmen argued the government made a tactical choice. He said they sought injunctive relief instead of criminal prosecution. He claimed this deprived the opposing sides of a jury trial.
Chief Justice Rehnquist thanked General Underwood. He stated the case was submitted.
